question: A can repair 11 benches in an hour and B can repair 5 benches in an hour. Determine how much time they will require to repair 64 benches when they work together?

question: Manoj and his wife Swathi fill a tank with water fetched from a well. Manoj fetches 5 litres of water in 4 minutes whereas Swathi fetches 4 litres of water in 5 minutes. Find the time taken by them together to fetch 205 litres of water.

question: Working together Kamal and Sharth have to type a book containing 300 pages. Kamal takes 12 hrs to type 96 pages and Sharth takes 15 hrs to type 60 pages.
